seriesTitle: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe

episodes.title: The Sword of Grayskull
episodes.summary: Warrior witch Teela searches for the fabled Sword of Power's champion — and finds adventurous teen Adam and his Tiger Tribe friends, Cringer and Krass.

episodes.title: The Power of Grayskull
episodes.summary: Stunned by his newfound powers, Adam and crew race to Castle Grayskull to recharge the Sword of Power with Prince Keldor and his evil allies in pursuit.

episodes.title: The Heirs of Grayskull
episodes.summary: Adam discovers the truth about his forgotten past. But a surprise reunion with an unexpected relative leaves Adam and his friends buried in the dust.

episodes.title: The Champions of Grayskull
episodes.summary: Cringer, Krass, Teela and Duncan harness the power of Grayskull to unlock their inner heroes and help Adam resist evil trio Keldor, Evelyn and Kronis.

episodes.title: We Have the Power
episodes.summary: Skeletor's sidekicks plot behind his back. Teela is reluctant to power up with Adam's team, but stampedes of vicious beasts might not give her a choice.

episodes.title: Orko the Great
episodes.summary: Duncan reboots a robot who thinks he's a great magician and causes chaos around the castle. Kronis uses a clever disguise to bypass the royal guards.

episodes.title: He-Man, the Hunted
episodes.summary: Former foes confront Cringer, Adam and Krass in the jungle and reveal how the loyal tiger lost his claws. Teela attempts to pinpoint Keldor's location.

episodes.title: The Calm Before the Storm
episodes.summary: Kronis and Evelyn hire hunter R'Qazz as they plot to overthrow Skeletor. He-Man and King Randor fight side-by-side as a Havoc storm consumes Eternos.

episodes.title: Cry Havoc, Part 1
episodes.summary: Adam and the Masters of the Universe finally face Skeletor before he summons his own powerful Dark Masters for a savage showdown at Snake Mountain.

episodes.title: Cry Havoc, Part 2
episodes.summary: Krass and Ork-0 catch up to Adam and the heroes before they race to Eternos to save King Randor from Skeletor and his dark army's epic assault.

episodes.title: The World Above
episodes.summary: As Skeletor plots his next moves, He-Man and crew confront flashy King Stratos when Castle Grayskull lands among the clouds in the sky kingdom of Avion.

episodes.title: The World Below
episodes.summary: Teela, Ork-0 and King Randor venture underground to seek refuge with Teela's former mentor — and prevent him from making a fateful deal with Skeletor.

episodes.title: Eternia 2000
episodes.summary: He-Man and Skeletor race for a piece of the powerful sigil while aboard the high-speed rails. Expert bandit Mo'squita-ra darts in to add more trouble.

episodes.title: A Very Hungry Dragonfly
episodes.summary: He-Man continues the search for Eldress. In pursuit of the final sigil piece, Evil-Lyn and Sorceress must join forces to defy a Havoc-fueled dragonfly.

episodes.title: Meanwhile...
episodes.summary: While celebrating his birthday, Skeletor disappears into cosmic lockdown with Duncan. Trap Jaw and Beast Man take charge in Skeletor's sudden absence.

episodes.title: Divided We Stand
episodes.summary: Krass and Stratos team up to investigate the Mystic Mountains. He-Man and Teela cast their differences aside to ready up for Skeletor's looming attack.

episodes.title: The Battle of Avion
episodes.summary: He-Man and the heroes clash with Skeletor in the cloud city. Stratos makes a scene with his new allies. Ork-0 and Man-E-Faces come through to help.

episodes.title: The Fifth Nemesis
episodes.summary: Krass questions everything as she discovers her gem's connection to Havoc — and Skeletor. He-Man defends Castle Grayskull from an unexpected new foe.

episodes.title: The Haunting of Castle Grayskull
episodes.summary: In ghostly form, Skeletor reveals hidden secrets about Castle Grayskull as he summons his slithering armies to keep He-Man and crew away from its walls.

episodes.title: Frozen Solid
episodes.summary: Krass questions her ties with Skeletor. Teela and Duncan reunite with Eldress in an icy tundra while He-Man and his dad battle forces in the forest.

episodes.title: Wrath of the Mer-Man
episodes.summary: Duncan, Teela and Eldress try to get their tech to work underwater to escape the Mer-Man. Evil-Lyn and her fellow fiends restore their dark powers.

episodes.title: The Tomb of Grayskull
episodes.summary: The battle's on between the Masters and the Mer-Man. He-Man tries to get Krass back on his side and stop Skeletor's wicked plot to be reborn.

episodes.title: A Leap of Faith
episodes.summary: He-Man gets a tempting taste of Havoc and abandons King Randor and crew on the ice to go solo. Skeletor begins his evil magic.

episodes.title: In-Can't-Ation
episodes.summary: With help from Teela, Ork-0 meets the one and only Orko the Great to find a spell that can remove Havoc from Adam. Evil-Lyn questions her motivations.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the End (Part 1 of 2)
episodes.summary: Skeletor unveils the full extent of his Havoc-fueled plans to the people of Eternos. Desperate Teela offers an unlikely truce to strengthen their side.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning (Part 2 of 2)
episodes.summary: With Eternia on the brink of destruction at Skeletor's hands, can He-Man and the Masters rally together to show who holds the ultimate power?
